description: An HTML file that includes a script defining a Calculator class extending Service, which registers methods for addition and subtraction via a JavaScript Service framework. It also initializes a ServiceManager to connect to a server and register the Calculator service.

classes.name: Calculator
classes.description: A class extending Service that defines 'add' and 'sub' methods to perform basic arithmetic operations and registers them for remote invocation.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Calculates the sum of parameters, logs the operation, and resolves the result in a Promise.

methods.name: sub
methods.description: Calculates the difference between two parameters, logs the operation, and resolves the result in a Promise.
